comparison.objective: Withdraw an index latch, swing a footrest, and settle it into its stowed capture; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual latch withdrawal and hinged-part swinging versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, and controlled tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Footrest reaches and remains in capture after the latch-mediated swing versus two safe impact cycles with negligible setting drift. Exact capture bands are referenced but absent; no separate specs exist.
comparison.reason: Although both contain unlocking and final retention, one tests indexed hinged stowage and the other dynamic parameter tuning.
